text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Grass Wonder—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today.Thanks to you, I got to have a nice little breather~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Oh? That person over there...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Geez... What should I do?
I just can't seem to cross.

An elderly lady holding a large bundle of luggage
was standing before the pedestrian crossing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Excuse me, ma'am over there—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for going out of your way, young lady.
You were a huge help~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, no, not at all~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. So humble and well-mannered...
The term 'Yamato Nadeshiko' fits this Umamusume perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you flatter me.

Grass Wonder remained bowed
until the elderly woman was completely out of sight.
choice_data_list: Just like Grandma said, you really are a proper Yamato Nadeshiko.
Just like Grandma said, you really are a proper Yamato Nadeshiko.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, even you, Trainer...?
Thank you so much~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, right after I returned to Japan, I was far less used to everything than I am now~.
choice_data_list: Like a language barrier or something?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Getting used to the subtle nuances and intonation only happened after coming here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Until then, well...
I wasn't very good at it, to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, indeed.
It's a little embarrassing, though...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Speaking properly was very difficult, yes!
I worked desperately to fix it before coming to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Something like this, perhaps?
Hehe, I won't be doing it again, though.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Both back then and now, I'm still immature and indecisive.
Calling me a traditional Yamato Nadeshiko is just way, way too much~.

It was something that happened on the way home,
where I discovered an unexpected side to Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, not particularly. In part due to my mother's tastes,
I often ate Japanese food even back in America.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Still... let's see.
There was just one food that surprised me at first."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —This is authentic wasabi.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I heard it was completely different from America,
but I never expected such a sharp, stinging pain...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's entirely my favorite food now,
but it took quite a bit of effort back then~
